description: This file defines the interface for CCSP CWMP configuration within the CCSP TR-069 PA. It contains function declarations, macros, and licensing information related to CWMP configuration and management, such as certificate location retrieval, configuration file loading, and timeout settings.

methods.name: CcspTr069PaSsp_SetOpensslCertificateLocation
methods.description: Sets the OpenSSL certificate locations; available only if _ANSC_USE_OPENSSL_ is defined.

methods.name: CcspTr069PaSsp_CcspCwmpCfgNoRPCMethods
methods.description: Returns the number of RPC methods supported by this configuration.

methods.name: CcspTr069PaSsp_CcspCwmpCfgGetDevDataModelVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the device data model version (major and minor).

methods.name: CcspTr069PaSsp_GetHttpSessionIdleTimeout
methods.description: Gets the HTTP session idle timeout duration.

methods.name: CcspTr069PaSsp_GetCwmpRpcTimeout
methods.description: Gets the CWMP RPC timeout duration.

methods.name: CcspTr069PaSsp_GetCustomForcedInformParams
methods.description: Retrieves custom parameters for forced inform.

methods.name: CcspTr069PaSsp_GetTr069CertificateLocationForSyndication
methods.description: Gets the TR-069 certificate location for syndication purposes.

methods.name: CcspTr069PaSsp_JSON_GetItemByName
methods.description: Fetches a JSON item value by partner ID and item name.

methods.name: CcspTr069PaSsp_LoadCfgFile
methods.description: Loads a configuration file by filename.
